limitations: These are emulated completed-pose FPS, not physical-hardware measurements or GIF playback speed.
Presentation remains VBlank-safe; intervals are quantized to display refreshes and include host costs. GSU-only timing is a separate measurement.
Both compiler variants use identical revised host code and unchanged frozen payloads from the preceding optimization comparison. Removing the old presentation hold is not a compiler optimization.
The 64-interval steady-state window includes poses 1..63 and the return to pose 0; it excludes the initial pose 0 render.
Repeated refreshes are intentional: a slow render keeps the last complete image visible without advancing the pose or presenting partial work.
